document.title: Pharos view and tab inventory
document.purpose: A structured inventory for reviewing whether Pharos exposes enough OpenAlex evidence to understand representation gaps and judge fitness for an intended analysis.
review_request: Identify important evidence, coverage measures, denominators, drill-downs, or caveats missing from each tab.
Identify information placed in the wrong tab or duplicated without a clear reason.
Check whether every measure helps a user understand how OpenAlex represents the selected entity or whether the data is fit for a stated analysis.
Flag any wording that could imply causality, Award receipt, administrative responsibility, identity certainty, completeness, or quality when the data does not support it.
Suggest additional global or peer context only when its comparison population and denominator can be stated defensibly.

product_aim.primary: Show what OpenAlex contains about an organisation, researcher, funder, journal/source, or publisher.
product_aim.secondary: Show where relevant metadata is missing, ambiguous, incomplete, or dependent on entity resolution.
product_aim.decision: Help a user estimate whether the OpenAlex evidence is fit for the analysis they intend to perform.
not_claimed: A complete administrative or commercial portfolio
An authoritative staff, grant-recipient, employment, or publication roster
Certification that an external system is ready to receive the data

cross_view_behaviour.default_corpus: OpenAlex core Works unless a tab states otherwise
cross_view_behaviour.time_scope: User-selected complete calendar years; the current year can be included and is labelled partial. Researcher views cover the complete recorded career.
cross_view_behaviour.snapshot_model: Aggregate results are saved with retrieval date, scope, implementation version, and query provenance. Record lists are separate live lookups and may have changed.
shared_controls: Explicit period selection for institution, funder, source, and publisher views; researcher views deliberately use the complete recorded career
PDF, Excel, CSV, and JSON export
Live record inspection and visible-record CSV export where supported
shared_interpretation_rules: Missing metadata means no assertion is recorded in the snapshot, not that the underlying fact is absent.
Counts use whole Works unless another denominator is displayed.
Institution and country groups can overlap because a Work can contain several affiliations.
Subject percentages use classified Works where stated; unclassified Works are shown separately.
OpenAlex records and links change over time.
Ranked lists are not statistical samples unless explicitly described as sampled.
Bar length may be scaled to the largest displayed share; printed counts and percentages are authoritative.

institution.label: Research organisation
institution.entity: OpenAlex Institution, normally confirmed with ROR when available
institution.population: Core Works in the selected period linked to the selected institution under the report's affiliation scope.

tabs.label: Overview
tabs.purpose: Summarise the represented output and its change over time.
drill_downs: Works for selected years or categories
Coverage summaries link to the dedicated Coverage gaps and Funding tabs
caveats: Counts reflect the OpenAlex institution mapping, not an independently verified institutional publication list.

tabs.label: Coverage gaps
tabs.purpose: Locate missing metadata and determine whether gaps concentrate in particular years, fields, sources, or work types.
caveats: A missing field in OpenAlex does not prove the source record lacks it.
The newest year may be partial or less mature.

tabs.label: Subjects
tabs.purpose: Show how OpenAlex classifies the institution's represented Works.
denominators: Subject percentages use Works with a primary Topic.
SDG tags overlap and do not sum to 100%.
drill_downs: Select a displayed Domain, Field, Subfield, Topic, or SDG to inspect supporting Works
caveats: OpenAlex assigns one primary Topic to a classified Work.
SDGs are model predictions based on titles and abstracts.
Only leading groups are displayed.

tabs.label: Outputs & access
tabs.purpose: Assess whether publication formats and access metadata support output- or access-focused analysis.
caveats: Work type is a format description, not a quality category.
Open-access status is a changing database assertion.

tabs.label: Citations
tabs.purpose: Show citation-link coverage and normalized citation flags recorded by OpenAlex.
caveats: These are database signals, not an institutional ranking.
Citation links and percentile flags change over time.

tabs.label: Sources & versions
tabs.purpose: Show where represented output appears and whether submitted and published versions are linked.
drill_downs: Works for a selected publisher or version pattern
caveats: Leading lists are not complete inventories.
A Source can be a journal, repository, conference series, book series, or platform.

tabs.label: Collaboration
tabs.purpose: Show institutions and countries co-occurring on the same represented Works.
drill_downs: Shared Works for a selected institution or country
caveats: Counts overlap.
Co-occurrence is not partnership strength, contribution, or impact.
Country comes from recorded institution metadata.

tabs.label: Funding
tabs.purpose: Separate direct Awards naming the institution from Work-level funding acknowledgements.
information: Award records naming this institution as recipient
Award and funder record details where available
caveats: A Work-level funding link does not identify which co-authoring institution received the Award.
Direct Award records and Work acknowledgements are different populations.

tabs.label: Researchers
tabs.purpose: Provide recognisable profiles for a plausibility check of institutional discoverability.
information: Researchers whose latest known OpenAlex institution is the selected institution
caveats: Not a staff roster.
Not a performance ranking.
Profile identity and affiliation history may be incomplete or incorrect.

tabs.label: Affiliations
tabs.purpose: Audit published affiliation strings that map, or might plausibly have failed to map, to the institution.
caveats: Name-compatible strings require human validation.
Possible matches are not automatically reassigned.

tabs.label: Institution record
tabs.purpose: Expose the OpenAlex entity used to define the snapshot.
caveats: These are source assertions, not details inferred by Pharos.

researcher.label: Individual researcher
researcher.entity: OpenAlex Author profile, optionally confirmed with ORCID
researcher.population: All Works assigned to the selected Author profile across its complete recorded career.

tabs.label: Identity
tabs.purpose: Determine whether the profile appears to represent the intended person before analysing it.
drill_downs: Works using a selected author-name variant
Works shared with a selected co-author
caveats: OpenAlex Author profiles are algorithmically resolved and can merge several people or split one person.
Compatible names are supporting evidence, not identity proof.

tabs.label: Career evidence
tabs.purpose: Assess the profile's longitudinal shape and the metadata available for common analyses.

affiliations: Institutions and years derived from Works assigned to this profile
funding: Award or funder links occurring on Works authored by the profile

caveats: Affiliation history is not an ORCID employment record.
Funding on a co-authored Work does not establish that this researcher received or led the Award.
SDG tags are predictions and can overlap.
Citation signals are not a peer comparison.

tabs.label: Merge / split review
tabs.purpose: Explain deterministic evidence that may justify human review of the Author profile.
information: Identity partitions proposed from incompatible evidence
Name, ORCID, affiliation, field, and co-author signals
Merge candidates with compatible names and at least two overlap signals
drill_downs: Inspect Works assigned to a proposed identity
Inspect outlier, unassigned, or excluded Works
Inspect overlap evidence listed for merge candidates
caveats: Pharos does not automatically merge or split OpenAlex profiles.
Recommendations are review aids, not identity adjudications.

funder.label: Funder
funder.entity: OpenAlex Funder, normally confirmed with Crossref Funder ID when available
funder.population: Core Works in the selected period carrying recorded funding metadata for the selected funder or one of its Awards. Direct Award aggregates can cover all recorded Award years.

tabs.label: Evidence overview
tabs.purpose: Show how OpenAlex represents the selected funder and separate direct Award evidence from Work-level funding evidence.
caveats: Direct Awards and Work-level acknowledgements are distinct traces.
Neither trace is a complete administrative portfolio.
Work links do not assign recipient, investigator, or administering roles.

tabs.label: Award records
tabs.purpose: Inspect direct Award records and the fields OpenAlex has actually received.
information: Currency distribution for Awards with positive amounts
Awards linked to the most publications
display_rules: Description preview is limited to 42 words and can be expanded.
Chart headings state Start year, Bar vs largest share, Share, and Awards.
Printed values are authoritative; bars are scaled within the displayed chart.
caveats: Ranked record views are not samples and are not used to estimate field completeness.
Blank fields mean OpenAlex has not supplied that assertion for the record.
Award-year scope is independent of the selected Work-level period.

tabs.label: Research themes
tabs.purpose: Show classifications of publications linked to the selected funder.
caveats: These classify linked Works, not Award records.
SDG tags overlap and are predictions.

tabs.label: Institutions
tabs.purpose: Show affiliation coverage and leading affiliated institutions on linked Works.
information: Leading affiliations over the selected period
caveats: Authorship affiliations are not Award recipients, investigators, administrators, or funding totals.
Institution counts overlap when a Work has several affiliations.

tabs.label: Outputs
tabs.purpose: Show the volume and publication formats of Works carrying funding links.
caveats: The link does not identify the author or institution that received or administered an Award.

tabs.label: Access
tabs.purpose: Assess open-access status on linked publications.
caveats: Access status does not establish a funder policy requirement or compliance decision.

tabs.label: Citations
tabs.purpose: Show citation links and normalized flags for linked publications.
caveats: Not a measure of Award quality, programme performance, causal impact, or funding return.

tabs.label: Global context
tabs.purpose: Place the selected-funder view beside global OpenAlex funding coverage without mixing the two scopes.
information: Exact total Funders with at least one Award record
Exact total Funders with at least one linked publication
All publications with a funding link
Countries of Funders with Award records
Countries of Funders with linked publications
Countries asserted for Award recipient institutions
Annual Award-record volume for the selected period
Annual linked-publication volume for the selected period
denominators: Funder-country shares use the corresponding exact Funder total.
Recipient-country shares use all Award records, so missing recipient-country assertions remain visible as an unaccounted remainder.
Annual shares use records within the selected year range.
tabs.known_unavailable_measure: Exact distinct Funders by year. OpenAlex grouped results are truncated at 200 and the Funder endpoint cannot filter through Award start year or Work publication year.
caveats: Global context is not about the selected funder.
Funder country is the awarding side.
Award recipient country uses an institution explicitly asserted on an Award.
Author-affiliation country on a linked publication is not relabelled as country awarded.

tabs.label: Funder record
tabs.purpose: Expose the OpenAlex entity used to define the view.
caveats: Entity metadata is an OpenAlex source assertion.

source.label: Journal or source
source.entity: OpenAlex Source, normally confirmed with ISSN-L or OpenAlex ID
source.population: Core Works in the selected period whose primary location is the selected Source.

tabs.label: Overview
tabs.purpose: Summarise represented output and format over time.
caveats: Primary-location scope excludes Works where the Source appears only in another location.

tabs.label: Subjects
tabs.purpose: Show how OpenAlex classifies Works primarily located in the Source.
caveats: SDGs are predictions and overlap.

tabs.label: Institutions
tabs.purpose: Show leading authorship affiliations on Works whose primary location is the Source.
caveats: Not a subscriber list, complete institutional inventory, or performance ranking.
Counts overlap.

tabs.label: Funding
tabs.purpose: Show funders linked on Works whose primary location is the Source.
caveats: Work-level links do not identify which author or institution received or administered an Award.
Missing links do not prove a Work was unfunded.

tabs.label: Open access
tabs.purpose: Show open-access status over time.
caveats: Open-access metadata and locations change over time.

tabs.label: Citations
tabs.purpose: Show citation-link and normalized percentile signals.
caveats: Not a journal ranking or quality judgement.

tabs.label: Source record
tabs.purpose: Expose how OpenAlex identifies the Source.
caveats: A Source may be a journal, repository, conference series, book series, or platform; type and identifiers must be checked before treating it as a journal.

publisher.label: Publisher
publisher.population: Core Works in the selected period whose primary Source belongs to the selected Publisher lineage.

tabs.label: Overview
tabs.purpose: Summarise output represented through the Publisher lineage.
caveats: Lineage can contain recorded imprints and subsidiaries and is not a commercial portfolio.

tabs.label: Sources
tabs.purpose: Show leading primary Sources assigned to the Publisher lineage.
caveats: Leading groups are not a complete title inventory.
OpenAlex Source types are heterogeneous.

tabs.label: Institutions
tabs.purpose: Show leading authorship affiliations on Works in the Publisher lineage.
caveats: Not evidence of contracts, subscriptions, customers, ownership, or institutional performance.
Counts overlap.

tabs.label: Subjects
tabs.purpose: Show the Fields and SDG predictions of Works in the lineage.
caveats: SDGs overlap and are model predictions.

tabs.label: Open access
tabs.purpose: Show access status across the Publisher lineage over time.
caveats: Not a publisher-policy or compliance measure.

tabs.label: Citations
tabs.purpose: Show citation-link and normalized percentile signals for represented Works.
caveats: Not a publisher ranking, market comparison, or quality judgement.

tabs.label: Publisher record
tabs.purpose: Expose the OpenAlex Publisher entity and lineage used for scope.
caveats: OpenAlex lineage is not guaranteed to match current legal ownership or a complete commercial portfolio.

readiness_review.purpose: Evaluate the saved evidence against requirements for a stated use without collapsing it into one general quality score.
limitations: Case-level, policy, identity, and external-system claims can still require human or external validation.
